archive.description: Link to an archived copy of the page held elsewhere

attachment.description: The captured page itself, stored as an attachment

capture-date.description: When the capture was taken. Distinct from the date the object was created: a capture fetched from an archive can be years older

domain.description: Domain the page was served from

link.description: Link to the capture as the capturing service publishes it

text.description: Text extracted from the captured page

description: A copy of a page as it was when somebody fetched it: the stored bytes, the text extracted from them, or a link to an archived copy, with the date the capture was taken. Complements `image`, which holds a screenshot and no date, and `domain-crawled`, which holds the URLs a crawl found and not what they returned.
name: page-capture
